nina (People Ops): Heads-up team: we have one-off process for manager extension requests this cycle — pls read.

omar (People Ops): tl;dr: managers can request a 72h extension for completing manager reviews for extenuating circumstances. Use the form.

zack (Director Eng): What's considered extenuating?

nina (People Ops): Examples: unplanned outage that pulled you into ops, family emergency, or key reviewer on leave. Not for procrastination.

sophia (Manager - ML): How do we request?

omar (People Ops): Fill the extension form: https://redwood.app/forms/ext-request?id=EXT-2026-01  — include impacted employees, reason, and whether an interim rating/comment is required.

julian (IC - Data): Will the extension change calibration slots? We already scheduled calibrations next week.

nina (People Ops): We try not to move calibration slots. If multiple managers in a cohort request extensions, we'll collapse them into the next calibration block and notify cohort leads.

sophia (Manager - ML): Who approves?

omar (People Ops): People Ops approves low-friction cases. If approval affects rollout (more than 5% of cohort) or touches compensation freeze windows, it escalates to Director + Finance.

zack (Director Eng): Noted. Please add me to any escalations for Eng.

nina (People Ops): Good call. The form auto-notifies the manager's director when escalation criteria hit.

julian (IC - Data): Can ICs request extensions directly?

omar (People Ops): No — manager-mediated only. We need manager confirmation that feedback will be collected.

sophia (Manager - ML): For tracking, will audits show who requested and the reason?

nina (People Ops): Yes: audit trail includes requester, timestamps, approver, and the free-text reason. It's stored for compliance for 3 years.

scheduler-bot: Reminder set: Calibration cohort A — Apr 05 15:00 UTC.

zack (Director Eng): If I approve an extension, does that change my team's calibration order?

omar (People Ops): It can. We have a small requeue window the day before calibrations open. If you're requeued, we email the cohort lead and update the calendar invite.

sophia (Manager - ML): One operational ask: can the extension form let us attach partial feedback files? we sometimes have snippets in Google Drive.

nina (People Ops): Yes — there's an "attach link" field (copy-paste drive links). We won't ingest doc content. Please ensure links have appropriate permissions.

julian (IC - Data): Are reviewers required to re-review if an extension was granted?

omar (People Ops): No automatic re-review. Managers should call out any material changes to the reviewer list or ratings in the form note; reviewers will be notified if needed.

zack (Director Eng): Anything else we should know about timelines?

nina (People Ops): Timeline summary: IC self-reviews due Mar 28, manager reviews due Apr 02, calibration window Apr 05-09. Extension requests can push manager reviews to Apr 05 (max 72h). Any extension beyond that requires Director + Finance sign-off.

sophia (Manager - ML): Thanks — i'll brief my managers in today's sync.

omar (People Ops): If anyone wants a quick walkthrough of the form, ping me and i'll run a 10-min demo.

nina (People Ops): Thanks all — please use the form rather than DMing us; it helps compliance and tracking. :smile:
